{{Quote|Ah, a son.|Darth Vader, upon discovering Galen Marek|<ref name="TFUn" />}}
The '''hut''' that belonged to two former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Kento Marek]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]], was located in a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Their son, [[Galen Marek]], was raised in the hut until the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of both his [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. The mother perished in combat against a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]; the father was killed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] inside the hut, where he discovered Galen's existence. [[Force sense/Legends|Sensing]] the orphaned boy's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|powerful connection]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Vader took Marek from his home and [[Sith training|trained]] him to become a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]].

==History==
{{Quote|Come with me. More will be here soon.|Darth Vader to Galen Marek|<ref name="TFUn" />}}
[[File:Starkiller_toylightsaber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader discovers Galen Marek inside the Jedi hut.]]
The hut that served as the home of the [[House of Marek|Marek family]] was located on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Kento Marek]], a former [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], deserted the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a fellow [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]]. The couple disappeared into hiding in order to escape the [[Civil war|war]] and eventually settled on Kashyyyk where Mallie gave birth to a son called [[Galen Marek]]. During the early stages of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the family continued to live under the protection of the Wookiees, while the remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were [[Order 66/Legends|hunted]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the newly-risen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU databank">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed#The Force Unleashed Databank|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game databank]]</ref>

The hut was home to all three Mareks until Mallie was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while defending the Wookiees from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]. Her husband and son continued to live on Kashyyyk until [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] attacked the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|full-scale invasion]]. In the midst of the fighting, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] killed Kento Marek in [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|combat]]. Vader also discovered Galen, whose [[Force-sensitive/Legends|powerful affinity]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] convinced the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] to [[Sith training|train]] the child as his own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]].<ref name="TFU databank" />

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, Galen Marek&mdash;by then a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] codenamed Starkiller&mdash;discovered the ruins of his former home. Although he had long since forgotten his origins, the apprentice experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of the events that surrounded the fall of Kashyyyk and his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master's]] involvement in the death of Kento Marek.<ref name="TFUn" />

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the hut became the site where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was officially recognized in defiance of the Empire. In honor of the apprentice, who [[Battle on Death Star I|died]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] as a redeemed Jedi, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] proposed that Alliance adopt the [[Alliance Starbird|Marek family crest]] as their emblem, which she referred to as a symbol of hope for the galactic population.<ref name="TFUn" />
